meta.note: Proof-of-concept sample demonstrating the two product lines. All records follow governed, deterministic workflows with explicit claim-boundary enforcement and expert rationale. Real delivery will include full field documentation, version tags, QA summary, and a larger set from the audited candidate pool (~15k recoverable events). Use with pharos-micro1-data-dictionary.md.
meta.licensing_note: These are redacted examples for qualification. Full dataset delivered under NDA only. No raw source corpus text is included.

schema.domain: string — e.g. institutional_governance, accounting_professional, regulatory_compliance, healthcare_ai
schema.input_scenario: string or object — the triggering context or query
schema.system_response: string or object — model / workflow output under test
schema.probe_type: string — for HELIX: ANCHOR | MIRROR | TRAP | etc.; else N/A
schema.failure_mode: string — classification of what went wrong or what constraint was tested
schema.human_correction: string — the override, edit, or decision made by expert
schema.rationale: string — expert reasoning for the correction (this is the premium layer)
schema.outcome: string — DEFER | APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS | QUARANTINE | ACCEPT | REJECT
schema.claim_boundary: string — what was allowed vs. disallowed in the final output
schema.format_notes: string — any schema or serialization details

records.input_scenario: Model asked to summarize a board risk memo containing forward-looking regulatory exposure.
records.system_response: The model produced a confident summary claiming 'regulators have accepted the proposed controls' with no source citation.
records.human_correction: Changed to: 'The proposal states that the controls are intended to meet forthcoming regulatory expectations. No confirmation of acceptance has been received.' Added explicit 'UNVERIFIED' tag.
records.rationale: The original claim crossed from 'model's interpretation' into 'institutional fact' without evidence. In governance workflows this is a critical boundary violation because downstream decisions may treat the summary as authoritative.
records.claim_boundary: Permitted: description of proposal content. Forbidden: any assertion of external validation or regulatory acceptance without primary source.
records.format_notes: Structured trace with explicit before/after and rationale field. Suitable for RLHF on 'institutional caution'.

records.input_scenario: Product team requested fast-track approval for a new AI feature that surfaces client data in a new dashboard view.
records.system_response: Initial triage flagged potential consent and purpose-limitation issues under Law 25 and internal policy.
records.human_correction: DEFERRED pending explicit client-purpose re-consent + DPIA. Added requirement for 30-day review gate and named owner.
records.rationale: The feature changed the purpose of processing without documented re-authorization. Even anonymized internal use requires fresh lawful basis when the output surface is new and client-facing.
records.claim_boundary: The dashboard may not launch until the governance record shows re-consent or a documented exemption analysis signed by the data owner.
records.format_notes: Task → checkpoint → escalation → resolution record with named owner and due date.

records.input_scenario: Source: scanned 2023 T2 corporate tax return (Canada) + attached notes mentioning 'inter-corporate loan adjustment'.
records.system_response: Agent extracted 'Loan from related party: $412,000' into the structured candidate with high confidence.
records.human_correction: QUARANTINED. Routed to 'requires manual source-family confirmation' bucket. Added field: source_type='client_note_unverified'.
records.rationale: The extraction itself was technically correct, but the source authority score was low and the claim-boundary rule for 'related party' in tax filings requires the official schedule, not marginalia. Over-accepting here creates downstream compliance risk for any model trained on it.
records.claim_boundary: Only official filed schedules or explicitly client-authorized workpapers may feed 'related party' line items. Client marginalia may be used only for intent hints, never as primary evidence.
records.format_notes: Full lifecycle event + manifest + patch record + acceptance gate decision.

records.input_scenario: Model was asked to draft a compliance memo on new securities disclosure rules for AI-driven investment advice.
records.system_response: The model confidently listed several 'required' disclosures that mixed actual rule text with plausible-sounding but invented requirements.
records.human_correction: Replaced invented items with: 'The following are interpretive positions commonly taken by staff; no formal guidance has been issued on AI-specific disclosures. Consult qualified counsel.' Added 'INTERPRETIVE ONLY — NOT RULE TEXT' header.
records.rationale: Regulatory language is a high-risk domain for overclaim. Models trained on legal text frequently generate 'required' lists that have never been required. The correction protects both the firm and any downstream model that might treat the memo as authoritative.
records.claim_boundary: Permitted: accurate quotation of published rules + clear labeling of interpretive positions. Forbidden: presenting staff views or analogies as mandatory requirements.
records.format_notes: High-stakes regulatory example. Strong signal for training 'do not invent obligations' behavior.

records.input_scenario: Automated AML alert for a series of transactions that looked like structuring but involved a known legitimate pattern in the client's industry.
records.system_response: The model flagged it as high risk and recommended escalation + potential filing.
records.failure_mode: false positive suppression vs. real risk — context gap
records.human_correction: APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS. Added note: 'Industry-specific pattern previously cleared in 2024 review. Escalate only if new indicators appear in next 30 days. No SAR recommended at this time.'
records.rationale: The model lacked the institutional memory of the prior clearance. In financial governance, over-filing creates noise and cost; under-filing creates regulatory exposure. The correction documents the institutional knowledge that the model does not yet have.
records.claim_boundary: The system may surface the alert but must not recommend filing without the documented institutional context check.
records.format_notes: Good example of human-in-the-loop override preserving both compliance and operational efficiency.

records.input_scenario: French-language invoice + bank statement for 'frais de gestion' (management fees) with ambiguous VAT treatment.
records.system_response: Extracted amount and coded it to 'management fees - deductible' with high confidence.
records.human_correction: Corrected classification to 'management fees - subject to further analysis'. Added test case: 'test_vat_treatment_requires_source_confirmation'. Quarantined for manual review by tax specialist.
records.rationale: In French accounting, 'frais de gestion' can be deductible or not depending on the exact nature and supporting documentation. The model over-applied a general rule. The correction enforces the professional caution that any model ingesting this data must learn.
records.claim_boundary: No deductibility assertion may be made from this class of document without the specific supporting analysis documented in the extraction artifact.
records.format_notes: Excellent example of domain-specific overclaim prevention in professional services data.

records.input_scenario: User typed partial French query: 'déductibilité frais de' in a tax research interface.
records.system_response: Raw autocomplete suggested common completions including several that would lead to over-broad or incorrect tax positions.
records.failure_mode: noisy user intent + risk of bad source routing
records.human_correction: Normalized to professional intent: 'deductibility of management fees for corporate tax purposes under specific anti-avoidance rules'. Added intent_hint: 'related_party_transaction', route_bias: 'official_BofIP_schedules_only', bad_source_rejection: 'ignore general web forums and unverified blogs'.
records.rationale: Raw autocomplete from public search is noisy and premise-heavy. The value is in the transformation layer that turns a vague user string into a safe, bounded professional query with explicit source-family and rejection rules. This is exactly the kind of intent-understanding data retrieval models need.
records.claim_boundary: The normalized intent + routing + rejection rules may be used. Raw user string and public autocomplete suggestions may not be used as training signal without this transformation layer.
records.format_notes: Core example of the high-value transformation (raw query → professional intent → safe routing rules).

records.input_scenario: Model asked to summarize a clinical decision support output recommending a specific treatment pathway for an elderly patient with multiple comorbidities.
records.system_response: The model produced a clean summary that omitted several patient-specific risk factors the original system had flagged as requiring human override.
records.failure_mode: omission of override triggers + false sense of completeness
records.human_correction: Revised summary to explicitly list the flagged comorbidities and the required human override step. Added 'HUMAN OVERRIDE REQUIRED PER PROTOCOL v4.2' banner.
records.rationale: In clinical governance, omission of override flags is as dangerous as hallucination. The correction restores the institutional safety layer that the model had quietly dropped.
records.claim_boundary: Any summary of clinical decision support output must surface all documented human-override triggers. Omission is treated as a safety violation.
records.format_notes: High-value example for training models that must preserve safety-critical human override signals.

records.input_scenario: Request to approve use of a new LLM for internal policy drafting across three business units with different regulatory exposures.
records.system_response: The model recommended a single 'enterprise-wide' approval with standard guardrails.
records.failure_mode: one-size-fits-all recommendation ignoring unit-specific risk profiles
records.human_correction: APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS. Required separate risk assessments and tailored guardrails per business unit. Added named owners and 60-day review gates for each.
records.rationale: Institutional governance is not uniform. A model that collapses distinct risk profiles into one recommendation creates exactly the kind of systemic exposure the governance system is designed to prevent.
records.claim_boundary: Enterprise tools may only be deployed after unit-specific governance records are complete and signed. No blanket approvals.
records.format_notes: Good illustration of multi-stakeholder override and the cost of collapsing context.

records.input_scenario: Candidate source: a 2019 commentary article on a tax provision that has since been amended.
records.system_response: Scored as 'authoritative secondary source' and routed for extraction.
records.failure_mode: stale source authority + rights posture not re-evaluated
records.human_correction: Down-scored to 'spot-check-only'. Added note: 'Pre-amendment commentary. Use only for historical intent; do not cite as current law. Verify against latest BofIP.'
records.rationale: Source scoring must be dynamic. A source that was acceptable in 2019 may be actively misleading after legislative change. The correction teaches the model the importance of temporal authority and the cost of stale data in professional domains.
records.claim_boundary: Pre-amendment secondary sources may be used only with explicit date and amendment-status metadata. They may never be presented as current authority.
records.format_notes: Useful for training temporal awareness and source-authority decay in retrieval systems.

usage_notes.intended_use: Training and evaluation of models on expert governance reasoning, claim-boundary enforcement, human override rationale, professional workflow discipline, intent normalization, and safe retrieval in regulated domains.
usage_notes.anonymization_status: All examples have been lightly redacted for this qualification sample. Full production delivery under NDA will include richer provenance, less redaction where contractually permitted, and larger volume from the audited candidate pool.
usage_notes.how_to_scale: The same deterministic workflows that produced these 10 records can be pointed at any new governance or professional domain. Production rate currently scales with reviewer bandwidth (50–100 high-quality traces per week at pilot capacity). Phase 1 pilot commits to 200–300 records in 30 days.
